Subject: superconductivity | ID: 53657

Assertion

Every semidefinite sigma-algebra f: X -> Y between real manifold spaces is uniformly continuous on compact subsets.

Step 3. By the stationary spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01330013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the stationary spectral family.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via asymptotic interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
